titleTr: B1 tekrar: modallar, koşul cümleleri, mülakat

explainTr: Modallar: must (zorunluluk), mustn't (yasak), don't have to (zorunlu değil), should (tavsiye), might (olasılık), could / would (nazik rica). Hepsinden sonra yalın fiil gelir.
Birinci koşul gerçekçi ihtimali anlatır: If + present simple, will + fiil. If I get the job, I will call you.
İkinci koşul hayalî ya da pek olası olmayan durumu anlatır: If + past simple, would + fiil. If I had more time, I would volunteer more. 'If I were ...' her özneyle 'were' kullanılır.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'eğer ... -sem, ...-rim' ya da '-ebilir / -meli' ekleriyle çok şey anlatılır. İngilizcede ek yok; yardımcı kelime var: must, should, might, would. Dikkat: 'mustn't' yasak, 'don't have to' ise sadece 'zorunda değilsin' demektir. İkisi Türkçede de tek ekte karıştırılabilir.

reading.title: Practicing for the interview
reading.text:
Hafsa has an interview tomorrow at Lincoln Elementary, so tonight she is practicing with Emre. He asks the questions, and she answers.

"What are your strengths?" Emre asks. "I am patient and reliable," Hafsa says. "I am also flexible, so I can change plans quickly."

"What is your weakness?" "My English isn't perfect yet. But I study every day, and I will keep improving."

"What would you do if two students started fighting?" Hafsa thinks for a moment. "I would stay calm and separate them if it is safe. Then I would call the front office. In a real emergency, I must follow the school rules." Emre smiles. "Good. What if a student refused to work?" "If a student refused, I would ask why. I might offer a small choice. I would never shout."

Next, Emre asks, "How would you motivate a shy student?" "I would encourage him with kind words," she says. "I might ask a simple question first, and I should praise every small success."

At the end, Emre says, "You can do this, Mom. You don't have to be perfect. You just have to be honest and prepared." Hafsa laughs. "If I get the job, I will cook baklava for the whole teachers' lounge!" Emre says that he will be the first one to taste it.

questions.whyTr: Metin: 'He asks the questions, and she answers.'

options: Her English is not perfect yet.

writing.promptTr: Mülakat sorusunu cevapla: Bir öğrenci çalışmak istemezse ne yaparsın? would, might, must ve if kullan (100-120 kelime).
writing.promptEn: Answer the interview question: What would you do if a student refused to work? Use would, might, must and if (100-120 words).
frames: If a student refused to work, I would ...
If the problem continued, I would ...
I think this is effective because ...
writing.model: If a student refused to work, I would stay calm and speak to him quietly. First, I would ask why he does not want to work. He might be tired, or he might not understand the task. If he did not understand, I would explain it again in a simple way. I must be patient, and I should never shout. If the problem continued, I would call the front office and ask for help. I think this is an effective plan because it is respectful, and it keeps the class safe. Every child is different, so I try to be flexible. If I were a student, I would like a teacher like that.
